title: Bumper: Correction
mood: sober: a rewind, then the motif backwards, resolving calmly
description: Segment bumper for Correction, built from Zoo's motif (3.4 s).
usage: Cut on the downbeat at the segment change; the music is finished before the file ends. -16 LUFS-I.
selfReview: Sober: a reversed piano swell (the rewind) runs straight into the motif played backwards, resolving to D minor. Critic round 1 (2026-11-24): the bus cut moved to 650 Hz (-4.5 dB) and the rewind is narrower (width 0.7): boxiness 0.7 dB (3.4 before), mono loss 1.0 dB and a windowed correlation minimum of +0.20 (1.5 dB and -0.05 before). It is still normalised to the same -16 LUFS-I as the other bumpers (the critic's optional -17 was not applied: the set stays level-matched); it loses 5.5 LU on the phone model, about what Zoo's voice loses.
